rows.Title: Municipal Road Resurfacing – Sector 14
rows.Description: Resurfacing and drainage works for Sector 14 arterial roads.

rows.Title: Sector 14 Arterial Road Resurfacing (Phase II)
rows.Description: Resurfacing of 6.4 km of arterial carriageway in Sector 14 including sub-grade correction, storm-water drainage repair, dense bituminous macadam and final wearing course.

rows.Title: Ward 7 Storm-Water Drain Rehabilitation
rows.Description: Desilting, reconstruction and covering of 2.3 km of open storm-water drain across Ward 7, including 14 cross-drainage structures.

rows.Title: Sector 14 Arterial Road Resurfacing (Phase II)
rows.Description: Resurfacing of 6.4 km of arterial carriageway in Sector 14 including sub-grade correction, storm-water drainage repair, dense bituminous macadam and final wearing course.

rows.Title: Ward 7 Storm-Water Drain Rehabilitation
rows.Description: Desilting, reconstruction and covering of 2.3 km of open storm-water drain across Ward 7, including 14 cross-drainage structures.

rows.ScopeDescription:
Milling of the existing bituminous surface across 6.4 km of the Sector 14 arterial carriageway.
Sub-grade correction and reconstruction of the granular sub-base where CBR falls below 8%.
Reconstruction of 1,850 m of kerb-side storm-water drain, including 42 gully gratings.
Laying of 50 mm dense bituminous macadam followed by a 40 mm bituminous concrete wearing course.
Thermoplastic road marking, cat-eye studs, and reinstatement of all signage to IRC:35 standards.
rows.PaymentTerms: Running account bills against completed milestones. 90% released within 30 days of departmental certification; 10% retention released on expiry of the defect liability period. GST at 18% payable against a valid tax invoice.
rows.LiquidatedDamagesTerms: Liquidated damages at 0.5% of the contract value per completed week of delay, capped at 10% of the contract value. Defect liability period of 24 months from the certified date of completion; rectification within 14 days of written notice, failing which the cost is recovered from the retention money.

rows.ScopeDescription:
Mechanical desilting and disposal of accumulated silt from 2.3 km of open drain in Ward 7.
Reconstruction of collapsed drain walls in RCC M25 over a cumulative length of 620 m.
Casting and placement of precast RCC covering slabs with lifting hooks at 3 m centres.
Reconstruction of 14 cross-drainage structures at road crossings.
rows.PaymentTerms: Running account bills on measured quantities certified by the site engineer. 95% released within 21 days of certification; 5% retention released after the monsoon performance test.
rows.LiquidatedDamagesTerms: Liquidated damages at 0.5% of the contract value per completed week of delay, capped at 10% of the contract value. The drain must remain functional throughout the monsoon; any blockage attributable to the works is rectified at the contractor's cost within 48 hours.

rows.InspectorRemarks: Site verified — shuttering matches reported progress.

rows.WorkDescription: Site office and labour camp established at Ch. 0+250. Topographic survey completed for the full 6.4 km with levels recorded at 25 m intervals. Traffic diversion plan approved by the traffic police and barricading erected on the northbound carriageway.
rows.InspectorRemarks: Mobilisation verified on site. Barricading and signage conform to the approved traffic plan.

rows.WorkDescription: Sub-grade correction completed between Ch. 0+000 and Ch. 3+200. Granular sub-base laid and compacted to 98% MDD; field density tests recorded at 12 locations. Storm-water drain reconstructed for 940 m with 21 gully gratings reset.
rows.InspectorRemarks: Field density results within tolerance. Drain invert levels checked against drawing SD-14/07 and found correct.

rows.WorkDescription: DBM laying in progress from Ch. 0+000 to Ch. 2+400 on the northbound carriageway. Mix temperature at laying recorded between 145°C and 152°C. Core samples lifted at three chainages and sent to the approved laboratory.
rows.InspectorRemarks: Laying temperature and rolling pattern satisfactory. Core results awaited before recommending departmental approval.

rows.WorkDescription: Desilting completed for the full 2.3 km. 1,240 cubic metres of silt removed and disposed at the designated municipal site; disposal challans enclosed with the milestone package.
rows.InspectorRemarks: Disposal challans tallied against measured quantities. Drain section clear along the full length.

rows.WorkDescription: Wall reconstruction in progress; 310 m of the 620 m completed. Progress slowed by unseasonal rainfall in the second week of May and by a utility conflict at Ch. 1+150 awaiting clearance from the water board.
